semantic_review.matrix_transpose: Root read exact original six-statement source, shared typed quotation, complete FPBits interpreter, Host allocation/execution/frame proof, final FullScope admission/outcome theorem, pinned frontend validators, all symbolic case partitions, wrapper meta/error probe and independent full-domain evidence validation. All natural shape dimensions are classified in source order; 231 accepted shapes exhaust the success domain. The one-program source transposes arbitrary fp16 bits without a numerical callback. Torch allocation/shape conversion and launch runtime are named trusted primitives; successful kernel values are derived by execution, never an oracle. Returned metadata and complete memory frame are preserved. Natural domain is explicit, negative/non-shape callers remain API failures rather than falsely generalized classifications. No native/GPU correctness claim.
semantic_review.relu_triton_kernel: Root read all four modules and matched seven AST statements plus frozen f64 SSA order. All pids compute 64-bit load/ordered compare/select before pid-zero store narrowing; inactive loads use supplied arbitrary words. Complete ordered source execution, trace, i32 offset/mask links, independent initial output/frame and unchanged tails are proved. Host dispatch calls the unchanged twelve routes and new fp64 grid; four fp8 rejection routes stop return. Product carriers have explicit branch projections and unselected carrier preservation. Native narrow/compare/literal correspondence is only proposed, not registered/validated. Remaining finite host metadata/view/configuration bindings and schema2 integration remain pending; known N>1024 full-ReLU claim stays false.
